functional: mean source target posterior over observed overlapping triples
fixed_component: source-reference-weighted additive A/B plus B/C functional projection; sufficient,not maximal identified component
outer_bounds: eight nonnegative atoms of collapsed target/A/C binary cube conditional on B; valid outer,not globally sharp or confidence intervals
witnesses: all 2x2x2 checkerboard circuits within B and profile pairs differing only one target bit; symmetric half-minimum-positive-corner amplitude
primary: A feasible positive circuit changing a cold target functional while all three complete constraint margins remain fixed refutes unique determination by those margins
zero_witness_rule: No eligible circuit or zero tested-circuit response does not certify identification
